name: yaps-memory
description: Persistent private memory for Codex, stored as local Markdown.

interface.longDescription: Remember facts across Codex chats, recall prior project context, search and cite private Markdown notes, and safely update a user-owned vault. The plugin, Yaps desktop setup, and trial or Yaps Pro activation can be completed in any order; the private local connection reconciles automatically. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also use the vault directly in Yaps.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yaps Memory. Check my connection, explain privacy and permissions, then guide me through my first useful action.
Help me capture a new memory in Yaps. Ask what I want to remember and where it belongs.
Summarize my five most recently updated Yaps notes and cite each note's title and path.
